hypothesis: The prior volatility head has more out-of-fold information than the return/cash head. Isolate conditional variance information inside one cost-aware allocator with the same annual risk budget, H5 prior means, covariance shape and dates. Distinguish learned information from simple persistence and the close-versus-open observation clock.

calibration.cutoff: Strictly before fit-year Jan1America/New_York; all parameters fixed for the following signalyear.
calibration.common_dates: Prior OOFavailability flag true; nextdaySOXXreturn and original5dayvoltarget both mature beforecutoff; samecalendarI_y for all4estimators. Minimum252pairs. No selective drops for invalid estimators.
calibration.risk_budget: B_y=mean((r1_i-mu1_y)^2) onI_y, ddof0; fixed DAILY variance, not annualized.
calibration.calibrators: c_j,y=B_y/mean(raw_marginal_j on I_y); every estimator receives the same one-scalar calibration opportunity.
calibration.conditional_covariance: Sigma_j,t=(c_j,y*m_j,t/Sigma_E,t[SOXX,SOXX])*Sigma_E,t. Budget isB_y for ALL variants; neverreplace itbyconditionalvariance, whichwouldcancelthesignal.
calibration.history_scope: H5means use all2011+maturelabels; calibration/B use2013+availableOOFdates. Separate counts/cutoffs are mandatory.
calibration.support: Report below/above prior inputmin/max as extrapolation flags only; no quantile clipping.
calibration.algebraic_interpretation: Since c_j=B/mean_I(m_j), Sigma_j/B=(m_j/mean_I(m_j))*(Sigma_E/Sigma_E22). Absolute B scale cancels under this common calibration; the TIME-VARYING marginal ratio remains. This tests normalized variance timing, not a separately adjustable budget-scale effect.
